description: One oscillator driving four outputs, each with its own waveform, phase and whole-number frequency multiple, for building Yamaha-style phase modulation.

params.text: Sets the pitch of the oscillator, 1.45Hz to 5920Hz, with 0 giving C4 at 261.63Hz.
Shifts the pitch by up to three semitones either way, finely near the centre of its travel.
Sets the waveform of that output on a scale of 0 to 10; whole numbers give sine, sawtooth, rectified sine, triangle and square, and positions between them blend the two either side.
Sets the phase of that output, a whole cycle either way.
Multiplies the frequency of that output by a whole number, 1 to 16.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, one volt per octave, added to the TUNE and FINE settings.
Adds to the waveform setting for that output, one step of the 0 to 10 scale per volt.
Shifts that output's phase, four tenths of a cycle per volt, added to its knob.
Adds to the frequency multiple for that output, 1.6 per volt, and the total is clamped to between 1 and 16 and rounded down.

outputs.text: The waveform of that output, at its own phase and frequency multiple.

menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
